description: National AI Strategy for Leap to AI G3 Powerhouse (Presidential National AI Committee & MSIT, September 26, 2024). Overarching national artificial intelligence strategy of the Republic of Korea issued by the Presidential National AI Committee and the Ministry of Science and ICT (MSIT), targeting AI infrastructure, sovereign AI compute, industrial AI adoption, and AI safety governance.
